groups.name: 0mega
groups.meta:
0mega is a ransomware group first observed in May 2022, operating with a double extortion model:
* Encrypting victim files (adding the .0mega extension)
* Threatening to leak stolen data if ransom demands are not met.
Ransom notes are na

posts.description: Exemplo Alimentos Ltda. (CNPJ 11.222.333/0001-81) is a food producer headquartered in Example City, Brazil, operating three plants and a distribution centre. We downloaded more than 400 GB of internal data: finance, contracts, supplier pricing and quality reports. If the company does not contact us, everything will be published. This text is a documentation placeholder that is deliberately longer than three hundred characters so that the excerpt limit is exercised by the tests.
initech.example Initech Inc. is a software company in Example City that supplies billing systems to Exemplo Alimentos and other food producers.
Personal tax files, family photos and identity documents of the owner.
